findings.description: After Link saves a reply into PDF notes, the question-history card still says web answer unregistered. Notes and reading evidence are correct, but the two areas give inconsistent completion feedback.
findings.next: Connect a saved Link note to its question-history card, while keeping explicit pasted answers distinct.

findings.description: Private bytes of the Paper Reader processes and portable wrapper reached 829.2 MiB with three pinned snapshots; 825.6 MiB near the end. Selected app/tunnel process-tree private bytes were 1041.4 MiB near the end. Last 30-minute totals were stable, but the footprint merits reduction.
findings.next: Measure renderer and per-snapshot search-worker costs separately; evaluate idle resource release while retaining immutable shares and reliable lazy recovery. This test does not establish a memory leak or rule one out in other workloads.

longRun.measurementScope: Read-only local MCP over the packaged EXE, already indexed snapshots; queries use a bounded parameterized LIKE search. These are not cold-indexing, remote-network, FTS relevance or ChatGPT generation latency measurements.
longRun.memoryScope: Aggregate private bytes of explicit Paper Reader/portable wrapper/Link launcher/tunnel roots and their descendants, including an existing Codex child. IAB process memory is excluded. Working-set sums can double-count shared pages and are not physical RAM attribution.
longRun.privacy: Local reports contain only selected process metrics and tool metadata; no credentials, cookies, prompt body, SQL excerpts or PNG base64 are copied into this repository report.
